turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: Frontier Home Lending / Invoca | check-in | Wed, Oct 21, 2026

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Morning, both. Thanks for making the time.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Morning, [PERSON_1]. [PERSON_2]'s on with us too.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Hi, [PERSON_1].

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Hi, [PERSON_2]. How's the week going so far?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Busy. Refi volume is cooling off, so we're doing a lot of looking at numbers and not much liking what we see.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Yeah, we're hearing that from a few lenders. Is it a steady decline or more of a cliff?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Steady, maybe fifteen percent down from the summer peak. Purchase is holding, refi is the soft spot.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Which makes every call count more, honestly.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Makes sense. What's top of mind for you two today?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: A couple of things. First, there's pressure from sales leadership. Our sales leadership has Gong for the loan officers, and they keep asking why we need Invoca's QM on top of it.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Okay. When they ask that, what are they comparing, exactly? The scoring, the coverage, the coaching workflow?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Mostly the scoring. They see Gong scoring calls for the loan officers and figure that's the same job.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Got it. Do you want me to put together something you can walk them through, like how the QM scorecards map to your compliance checks versus coaching?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: That would help. Something short, one page. They won't read more than that.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: I'll draft it and send it over for your review before it goes anywhere.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Appreciate it. Second thing, and this one's been bugging us for a few weeks. The Five9 integration is stamping the transfer time instead of the answer time, so our speed-to-answer report is off by about forty seconds on every transferred call.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Okay, that's a real gap. When did you first notice it?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Early October, I think. It was subtle at first because not every call transfers.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: It shows up in the Five9 reports too, so it's not just on your side.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Do you have a couple of example calls with the Five9 IDs? That'll help me get it in front of the right team.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: I can pull five or six from last week and send them today.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Perfect. I'll open a ticket and attach them, and I'll keep you posted on what I hear back.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Thanks.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: [PERSON_2], you had something on your list?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Yeah. We'd love an API endpoint for the dashboard metrics so we can pull them into Looker without the CSV export.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Okay. Which metrics are you pulling most often?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Call volume by campaign, conversion rate, and the signal counts. The weekly exec pack is built in Looker, so right now someone exports the CSV every Monday and it's manual.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: And how often would you want it refreshed if you had it?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Daily would be plenty. It's not real-time reporting, it's trend reporting.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Got it. I'll log that as a request and see where it sits. I can't promise a date, but I'll make sure it's captured with the detail you just gave me.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: That's all I ask.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Anything else on the Salesforce side? The loan application object sync has been quiet, as far as I can tell.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: It's fine. No issues there.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Yeah, that's been stable.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Good. How's the team handling the lower volume? Any changes to staffing?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: We've shifted a few folks to purchase campaigns. Nothing drastic yet, but if the trend continues we'll be looking at schedules in Q1.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Okay. If it's useful, I can pull your call trends by campaign before our next call so you have the numbers in one place.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: That would be useful. Especially the purchase versus refi split.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: I'll have that ready. Anything else before we wrap?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: No, I think that covers it. Thanks, [PERSON_1].

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Thanks. Looking forward to the API update, even if it's a no.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Understood. I'll follow up on the ticket and the one-pager this week. Talk soon.
